provenanceSearch.interpretation: This was a directed and non-exhaustive search. No exact match in the reviewed public-web result surface does not prove originality, authorship, clearance or universal absence of a prior source. It did not cover licensed databases, print-only works, deleted pages, translations, private documents, drafts or extensive paraphrase. Candidate factual sources were selected for later claim review; topical relevance or HTTP availability does not verify learner-facing claims, passage identity, authorship or rights.

sourceAvailability.method: Direct HTTPS GET with redirect resolution, a 30-second request cap, response-body SHA-256, content type and byte count. HTTP availability is recorded independently from factual claim review, authorship, licensing and rights verification.
sourceAvailability.interpretation: HTTP availability and response hashes do not establish factual support, authorship, originality, permission, licensing or publication rights. A 200 response is not a claim verdict; 403 and DNS failures are retained honestly as unavailable requested content. Browser or indexed access observed elsewhere is not substituted for this retrieval receipt. Each source retrievedAt is the shared batch-start marker, not a per-response completion timestamp or append-only witness.

factualResearch.limitation: Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan casos de outreach, horarios, paradas, costes y alianzas, pero no verifican market days, la comparación “as much as”, el conjunto exacto de destinos o una cadena causal universal. Disponibilidad no prueba autoría, licencia, hechos ni revisión humana.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan préstamo y devolución, adaptación local, documentación, almacenamiento y pruebas de germinación, pero no verifican cada geografía, rasgo, actor o práctica como universal de todo community seed bank. Disponibilidad no prueba autoría, licencia ni revisión humana.

Cobertura dirigida y parcial. Las fuentes candidatas respaldan ejemplos de acceso extendido, espacios de estudio, seguridad, servicios parciales, pruebas y permiso de guardianes, pero no verifican prevalencia, el bundle exacto, los conteos operativos ni cleaning staff. Disponibilidad no prueba autoría, licencia ni revisión humana.

shortcutReview.interpretation: Prompt-only exact guesses measure answerability from sentence frames without passage evidence; they are not expert adjudications.

studentWalkthrough.limitation: Blind content-only walkthrough; no students, UI or conformance test.

runtime.limitation: Explicit check, immediate post-check key/explanation, client answers and pre-response hints prevent representation as Practice or Exam simulation. Stored maxWords only drives a visual warning and does not block scoring.

canonicalAnswerGrammarSurface.caveat: Manual structural classification; it is not a statistical POS certification.

sampleAdequacy.conclusion: n=18 is too small to certify statistically balanced content.

applicability.evidence: Seven learner-facing files and fifteen-file closure remain pinned. UI/Playwright ➖ is not conformity.
